subject: stats: set the default analyze column options to all (#64994)
summary: Non-test behavior change is limited to switching the default `tidb_analyze_column_options` from `PREDICATE` to `ALL` (via `pkg/sessionctx/vardef/tidb_vars.go`) and adding bootstrap upgrade v254 to set `PREDICATE` only when the global var row is missing (`pkg/session/upgrade.go`). No correctness/semantics/consistency/concurrency/session/protocol Blocker/High issues found; later upstream removes the v254 upgrade as unnecessary (`c0659c1643`), further reducing any potential upgrade-version risk.
